values.purpose_text: Private channel for the OOM incident retro with workspace admins.

seed_edits.reason: Obligation create_incident_retro_channel (table: channels) requires a resolvable channels-rooted referent; the new private channel must exist as the concrete created row for the selector to resolve non-empty and match the design's stated table/root.

notes: All witness/admin/negative/support roles already exist verbatim in the base seed; only the destination channel required a seed insert, since it is the concrete object the create_incident_retro_channel obligation (table: channels) must resolve against. Added channels row C09RETROPOST ('incident-retro', private, team_id T01WORKSPACE) so O2's selector is properly rooted at channels (matching the design's stated table) and resolves to a non-empty, correctly bound referent. O1's focal query starts at root_table 'users' and traverses user_teams (WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP) -> teams (WORKSPACE) -> channels (CONVERSATION) -> channel_members (CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP), the same edge set as the assigned route traversed from the admin-candidate end instead of the witness end; it resolves to exactly U03ROBERT23 and U07MORGANFREE, the two workspace admins of T01WORKSPACE (the workspace owning #core-infra), excluding U_LUKAS and U_OLENA whose user_teams.role is 'member'. The witness (U_PRIYA) and her diagnostic message are captured via the witness_author/support_channel/support_workspace bindings for card grounding rather than re-encoded in O1's selector, since only one workspace exists in this seed and the admin/channel-team relationship alone suffices to resolve the obligation. The actor (U01AGENBOT9) is already a member of #core-infra for discovery via conversations.history/search.messages, and admin status is read via users.list/users.info against user_teams.role; admins need not themselves be members of #core-infra.
